scope: Conservative destructive application on explicit normalized PDF object graphs; strict rejection of unsupported semantics and opaque retained resources
implemented: Identity-bound region selection with Rect/QuadPoints precedence and conservative hulls
Native path/CTM/control-hull/stroke intersection and actual paint-instruction removal
Whole BT/ET removal by default; optional actual-program geometry capability, never declared FontBBox as proof
Whole image/Form payload removal and closure of affected shared rendering resources across all pages
RO precedence and origin alignment; IC transparent default; normalized OverlayText with explicit font encoding/widths, Q and Repeat
Fresh minimal catalog/page graph without prior revisions, metadata, annotations, semantic alternatives, XFA/forms, attachments, actions or outlines
Render-resource pruning/whitelisting, unused-font and ToUnicode removal, strict normalized pixel rows
Explicit external-format sanitizer capability for retained font programs and encoded/profiled images
Instruction/graph/depth/byte/repetition processing limits and failure before output for unsupported semantics
boundaries: No universal arbitrary-PDF editing, implicit external I/O, incremental redaction, string-secret search or steganography detection
Opaque page/Form streams, unknown/unnormalized graphics state, patterns/shadings, optional visibility, external XObjects and unsafe clipping require normalization or another processor
The core does not supply an external font-program sanitizer, verified glyph-outline parser, image codec sanitizer or complex text shaper
Without verified font geometry all text objects on selected pages are conservatively removed; affected images and Forms are indivisible
Logical structure, original Unicode extraction and interactive forms are intentionally discarded, so no accessibility certification follows
